learning_outcomes.text: The learner analyzes their career path in the company during their apprenticeship training.
The learner demonstrates their development during their periods in the company, the skills acquired, and their ability to project themselves as an Engineer.
The learner is able to hold an Engineer position in all its dimensions: organizational, scientific and technical, human, and economic.
The learner observes to understand the implementation of skills.
The learner can perform under supervision.
The learner can perform and train others.
The learner is capable of taking a step back, respecting specifications, and projecting into the future.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the learner's journey in the company during apprenticeship training
Evolution of the learner during company periods
Skills acquisition in the company (second year)
Ability to project oneself as an Engineer
Discovery of the company and integration into the professional world (first year follow-up)
Presentation of the company (about one page)
Reasons for the project (about one page)
Detailed presentation of the project (about one page)
Detailed presentation of the learner's positioning (about one page)
Presentation of the envisaged scientific development (about one page)
Presentation of the economic balance sheet (about one page)

assessment_methods.method: Maintenance of the Electronic Monitoring Logbook (Carnet de Suivi Electronique)
Liaison form completed at the end of each semester
Evaluation grid completed by the Industrial Tutor at the end of the year
Deliverable concerning the presentation of the End-of-Studies Project (PFE document)

assessment_rules: The evaluation is individual (EVI 1) with a coefficient of 1. The skills grid is filled by the Industrial Tutor at the end of the year and focuses on the skills acquired in the company during this second year. The End-of-Studies Project presentation will be examined by the Specialty Sector Commission, which will verify the document's conformity with PFE expectations.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
